part.text: The current implementation only handles multibyte characters and passes raw CR/LF through, which `Headers` rejects (and in raw adapters could enable injection). Let me implement the fix.

files.patch:
Index: src/context.ts
===================================================================
--- src/context.ts
+++ src/context.ts
@@ -769,13 +769,17 @@
     location: string | URL,
     status?: T
   ): Response & TypedResponse<undefined, T, 'redirect'> => {
     const locationString = String(location)
+    // Multibytes should be encoded
+    // eslint-disable-next-line no-control-regex
+    const encodedLocation = !/[^\x00-\xFF]/.test(locationString)
+      ? locationString
+      : encodeURI(locationString)
+    // CR and LF must be percent-encoded to prevent header injection
     this.header(
       'Location',
-      // Multibytes should be encoded
-      // eslint-disable-next-line no-control-regex
-      !/[^\x00-\xFF]/.test(locationString) ? locationString : encodeURI(locationString)
+      encodedLocation.replace(/[\r\n]/g, (char) => encodeURIComponent(char))
     )
     return this.newResponse(null, status ?? 302) as any
   }

## Changes

**`src/context.ts:768`** — `c.redirect()`
- Extracted the existing multibyte handling into `encodedLocation` (unchanged behavior for valid URLs).
- Added a final pass that percent-encodes raw `\r` → `%0D` and `\n` → `%0A` before setting the `Location` header, closing the header-injection vector while leaving already-encoded input untouched.

```ts
const encodedLocation = !/[^\x00-\xFF]/.test(locationString)
  ? locationString
  : encodeURI(locationString)
// CR and LF must be percent-encoded to prevent header injection
this.header('Location', encodedLocation.replace(/[\r\n]/g, (char) => encodeURIComponent(char)))
```

**`src/context.test.ts:118`** — 4 regression tests added:
- Raw CR → `%0D`
- Raw LF → `%0A`
- Raw CRLF → `%0D%0A`
- Already percent-encoded `%0D%0A` preserved (no double-encoding)

Each raw-CRLF/CR/LF test also asserts the injected header (`X-Injected`) is absent and status stays `302`.
